title: Grow a sorted prefix one key at a time
invariant: Before each outer step i, positions 0..i-1 hold the original first i values in sorted order.

frames.explanation: Sort [5,2,4,1]. Think of the left end as a sorted hand of cards. One card on its own is already sorted.

scene.description: Insertion sort normal: values [5,2,4,1], key -, j -.

frames.explanation: Pick up the next card, 2. Everything to its left is sorted; find where 2 belongs among them.

scene.description: Insertion sort normal: values [5,2,4,1], key 2, j 0.

frames.explanation: 5 is bigger than 2, so slide 5 one spot right to make room. (It shows up twice for a moment; the 2 is safe in a variable.)

scene.description: Insertion sort normal: values [5,5,4,1], key 2, j 0.

frames.explanation: Stop sliding: nothing is left to its left. Drop 2 into the gap at index 0. The first 2 values are sorted now.

scene.description: Insertion sort normal: values [2,5,4,1], key 2, j -1.

frames.explanation: Pick up the next card, 4. Everything to its left is sorted; find where 4 belongs among them.

scene.description: Insertion sort normal: values [2,5,4,1], key 4, j 1.

frames.explanation: 5 is bigger than 4, so slide 5 one spot right to make room. (It shows up twice for a moment; the 4 is safe in a variable.)

scene.description: Insertion sort normal: values [2,5,5,1], key 4, j 1.

frames.explanation: Stop sliding: 2 is not bigger than 4. Drop 4 into the gap at index 1. The first 3 values are sorted now.

scene.description: Insertion sort normal: values [2,4,5,1], key 4, j 0.

frames.explanation: Pick up the next card, 1. Everything to its left is sorted; find where 1 belongs among them.

scene.description: Insertion sort normal: values [2,4,5,1], key 1, j 2.

frames.explanation: 5 is bigger than 1, so slide 5 one spot right to make room. (It shows up twice for a moment; the 1 is safe in a variable.)

scene.description: Insertion sort normal: values [2,4,5,5], key 1, j 2.

frames.explanation: 4 is bigger than 1, so slide 4 one spot right to make room. (It shows up twice for a moment; the 1 is safe in a variable.)

scene.description: Insertion sort normal: values [2,4,4,5], key 1, j 1.

frames.explanation: 2 is bigger than 1, so slide 2 one spot right to make room. (It shows up twice for a moment; the 1 is safe in a variable.)

scene.description: Insertion sort normal: values [2,2,4,5], key 1, j 0.

frames.explanation: Stop sliding: nothing is left to its left. Drop 1 into the gap at index 0. The first 4 values are sorted now.

scene.description: Insertion sort normal: values [1,2,4,5], key 1, j -1.

frames.explanation: Every card has been placed: [1,2,4,5].

scene.description: Insertion sort normal: values [1,2,4,5], key -, j -.
